Interface SmartViewAssets

All Known Implementing Classes:
SmartViewAssetsImpl
public interface SmartViewAssets
Client interface for the IBX SmartView Assets API. Provides methods to list assets as a category/template/asset hierarchy, search assets, retrieve asset details and their tag points, and read current tag-point values.

  • Method Details

    • list

      AssetsList list(String accountNo, String ibx, String classification, List<String> cages)
      Lists monitored assets for the specified account/IBX as a category/template/asset hierarchy.
      Parameters:
      accountNo - the Equinix account number
      ibx - the IBX code identifying the data center
      classification - the asset classification to filter by (Electrical or Mechanical)
      cages - the list of cage unique space ids to filter by, or null for all
      Returns:
      the assets list hierarchy

    • getAssetDetails

      Parameters:
      accountNo - the Equinix account number
      ibx - the IBX code identifying the data center
      classification - the asset classification (Electrical or Mechanical)
      assetId - the unique identifier of the asset
      Returns:
      the asset detail envelope

      Returns:
